velocity_metric.name: whole-volume velocity RMSE
velocity_metric.evaluation: Truth consists of aligned 4000-m constant cubes; each truth cube is repeated four times per axis to match the 1000-m inversion cells. Equal-volume cellwise RMSE is therefore exactly the whole-volume RMSE of the piecewise-constant fields.
velocity_metric.verification: Recomputed from final_model.npy and source model.npz, and checked against quality.jsonl iteration 11.

hypocenter_metric.name: 90th percentile of Euclidean 3D location error
hypocenter_metric.checkpoint: iter_11, E-step before the twelfth velocity update
hypocenter_metric.estimator: Candidate with largest saved weight for each event, in both modes
hypocenter_metric.event_order: Source events.csv order, as returned by load_tomography_experiment
hypocenter_metric.quantile: numpy.percentile(errors, 90), default linear interpolation; equal event weights
hypocenter_metric.verification: All 1200 weights.npz files loaded for each run; positions and weights finite, weights sum to one.

pair_verification: The hard/soft pairs with configured top-N equal to the full tested set (50 or 100) differ only in candidate_mode and run_name. The top-10 and top-25 soft comparisons additionally change weights_top_n and reuse the historical hard-50 control, as specified by the top-N study. Numerical setup is unchanged apart from tested/retained candidate counts and assignment; new runs use 12 workers instead of 4 and explicitly disable held-out picks. Initial arrays and station coordinates agree, all runs have 12 complete iteration markers, and source inputs were validated by load_tomography_experiment. No inversions or forward solves were rerun.
control_reuse: hard_50 is one run reused in three comparisons, not three independent replicates.
